Thin initial releases are t38..57 only. mnar_outage post-warmup response probability is 0.23 if abs(y)>1.1 else 0.85, multiplied by .6 for the independent feature outage mask; shared across all arms.
features: stable=x; redundant=x+.003 Gaussian; context=z; fading reliability r=(125-t)/35 clipped to [0,1] replacing x with independent component; perturb adds .85 Gaussian after tick59; delayed and missing share the same paired outage mask on ticks 75..134 at 40%, delayed +6 and omitted from current decision; wide appends all six Gaussian noise columns.
selection: Choose one noise column by largest development-seed mean absolute correlation on labels released by tick59, current feature manifest and fit preprocessing frozen before report. Noise candidates retain all attempts; no true report holdout.
